subject: english
stem: This conversation takes place before the first class. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: an invitation to the Monday school show at the library
an invitation to a show at the library on Wednesday
a request to move the show from the library
a question about tickets for the library

optionRationales.reason: an invitation to the Monday school show at the library：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。

an invitation to a show at the library on Wednesday：此項把「the Monday school show at the library」改成「a show at the library on Wednesday」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。

a request to move the show from the library：此項把「an invitation to the Monday school show at」改成「a request to move the show from」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。

a question about tickets for the library：此項把「an invitation to the Monday school show at」改成「a question about tickets for」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Monday school show at the library」。
